declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties negotiated through competing term sheets. Hargrove Lane initially proposed a $42 million class fund and $10 million in fees, with automatic distribution and any unawarded fees reverting to the class. Brightline proposed a $23 million fund and $4 million in fees, also with automatic distribution, but with unawarded fees reverting to Brightline. Hargrove Lane rejected that reversion provision and countered with a $30 million class fund and $5 million in fees, preserving automatic distribution and providing that unawarded fees revert to the class. The parties reached a binding settlement on those final terms. Brightline does not have a clear-sailing provision and may oppose the fee request; all fees remain subject to court approval.
